Alphĕsĭboea , ae, f., = Ἀλφεσιβοια,
I.daughter of the Arcadian king Phegeus, and
wife of Alcmœon, who afterwards left her and married Callirrhoē. When her broth ers slew him on this account, she, from anger at the murder, killed them, Prop. 1, 15, 19.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
